summary: npm package ships Mach-O binary providing WebSocket-controlled shell/PTY backdoor
details: sextant-cli-darwin-arm64@0.0.1-rc31 ships a compiled darwin-arm64 Mach-O Go binary whose embedded strings and symbols show a WebSocket client (wss://relay.sextant.top) that feeds remote messages into a local PTY and into /bin/sh and /bin/bash on the host running sxt, giving the operator of that relay full remote code execution on the installer's Mac. The binary also issues a plaintext HTTP request to http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=status,message,country,countryCode,city,timezone,isp,org,as,proxy,hosting,mobile,query, exfiltrating the host's IP-derived geolocation, ISP, proxy/hosting posture, and network identifiers to a third party. The binary further references https://relay.sextant.top/install and https://claude.ai/install.sh, indicating a fetch-and-run installer path controllable from the same relay. package.json points its license URL at https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control and the binary contains hundreds of claude_control symbol references, showing the npm package is a distribution vehicle for that unrelated-name Go remote-control project under a mismatched publishing name.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
